bio: Enjoy Afternoon Tea at EL&N London, the world's most Instagrammable café. Experience a fresh take on Afternoon Tea in EL&N's famously distinct pink and floral interior.  EL&N's Afternoon Tea is exclusive to their Lowndes Street location. You'll sit immersed in their unique, bright pink and floral interior.  The Afternoon Tea menu provide visitors with a choice of savoury or sweet. To start with, they offer delicious, creamy warm fruit scones with butter, fruit preserve, and clotted cream, and a selection of savoury sandwiches, including tuna, dill, and cucumber mini canapes, smoked salmon, cream cheese, and dill hearts, or chicken, avocado, and harissa aioli crowns. Afternoon Tea is also served alongside a selection of excellent mini cakes, with a mixed berry cheesecake, mini banoffee pie, and more. Refreshments include a selection of either EL&N House Coffee or London Tea.  EL&N Lowndes Street is an eight minute walk from Knightsbridge station.  Afternoon Tea is offered for two. Price shown is per person.
